name: Ideas
description: Every idea and project you have for later, in one place: capture one in a line, give it a status and notes, group it into phases, and hand it to your coding agent to plan when its time comes. Your agent's sessions can save ideas here too.
author: cockpit

settings.label: Planning an idea with your agent
settings.default:
Here's an idea from my list, for {project}. Help me turn it into a plan: what it involves, what we already have that it can build on (look in this folder when it's the right codebase), the open questions, the risks and a first breakdown into small steps. Ask me what you need before writing the plan.

{idea}
settings.help: {project} becomes the project's name and {idea} the idea with its notes

settings.label: Statuses
settings.help: In order. The last two count as finished and are hidden unless you ask for them
